fact: NISR's Formal External Trade in Goods report for the third quarter of 2025 (July to September 2025), dated December 2025, states its data are compiled by NISR from data collected by the Rwanda Revenue Authority Customs Department as part of its routine activities to manage, monitor and facilitate cross-border trade.
title: Formal External Trade in Goods, Third Quarter 2025
publisher: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda
